selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure persistent resource limits
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, root-owned limits configuration, and effective soft/hard limits of nofile=8192 and nproc=256 in an appworker login session.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a8d103a5-6bbc-4adc-a4b1-7b779fe8fdc3, running system state, persistent account/configuration, and recovered effective limits.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
cat /etc/os-release
printf '\naccount:\n'
getent passwd appworker || true
printf '\nlimits files:\n'
ls -l /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d
printf '\nexisting appworker rules:\n'
grep -R -n -E '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '\npam limits references:\n'
grep -R -n 'pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null; then
  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
fi
printf '%s\n' \
  'appworker soft nofile 8192' \
  'appworker hard nofile 8192' \
  'appworker soft nproc 256' \
  'appworker hard nproc 256' \
  > /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
getent passwd appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
appworker:x:1000:1000::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
root:root 644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256

commands.command:
set -eu
runuser --login appworker --command 'printf "user=%s uid=%s
" "$(id -un)" "$(id -u)"; printf "nofile soft=%s hard=%s
" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)"; printf "nproc soft=%s hard=%s
" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"; grep -E "^(Max open files|Max processes)" /proc/$$/limits'

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='
systemctl is-system-running || true
getent passwd appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
runuser --login appworker --command 'printf "login_user=%s nofile=%s/%s nproc=%s/%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"'

set -eu
old_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' >/tmp/antrieb-reboot.log 2>&1 &
printf 'reboot_ack node=%s old_boot_id=%s scheduled=yes\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$old_boot"

set -eu
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$new_boot"
printf 'system_state='
systemctl is-system-running
getent passwd appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/appworker /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
runuser --login appworker --command 'printf "user=%s uid=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(id -u)"; printf "nofile soft=%s hard=%s\n" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)"; printf "nproc soft=%s hard=%s\n" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"; grep -E "^(Max open files|Max processes)" /proc/$$/limits'
